title: Admin Settings Configuration Authority
problem: Global settings are loaded from TOML at startup and copied into runtime/router state, so Admin Web cannot safely expose settings mutation until a backend source of truth exists.

evidence.summary: Opened backend configuration-authority lane after Admin Web settings mutation readiness showed no safe global settings source of truth.

Selected metadata raw cache retention as the first safe global settings field group with persisted Admin desired-state, TOML-first startup merge, restart-required PUT semantics, and redaction-safe route shape.
Implemented GET/PUT /admin/v1/settings/metadata/raw-cache, SQLite/PostgreSQL settings persistence, startup override merge, generated Admin contract DTOs, HTTP docs, and focused Rust gates.

Reviewed, verified, and closed the backend settings authority lane with handoff back to Admin Web settings mutation for metadata raw cache controls only; PostgreSQL runtime contract remains skipped locally without NAKO_TEST_POSTGRES_URL.

continue_policy.notes: Closed. Continue in admin-web-v2-settings-mutation-authority ASM-030/ASM-040 for UI controls limited to metadata raw cache settings.
